title: ClawBench: Can AI Agents Complete Everyday Online Tasks?
best_for_zh: 需要审计 live-web agent、生产网站漂移、账号状态、最终提交拦截和真实副作用边界的读者。
one_line: ClawBench evaluates web agents on everyday online tasks across live production websites.
ClawBench 在 144 个 live platforms 上评估 153 个日常在线任务，并用 final-submission interception 控制真实副作用。
why: It is a live-web evaluation surface where environmental drift and real-world side-effect control are central.
inclusion_reason: It pushes web-agent evaluation from static sandboxes toward live production workflows with safety interception.

title: Problem
问题
html:
ClawBench asks whether AI web agents can complete routine online tasks on real production websites. The primary source is the 2026 arXiv paper "ClawBench: Can AI Agents Complete Everyday Online Tasks?" with project page listed as https://claw-bench.com.

The decision boundary is that this is a live-web agent benchmark, not a static webpage sandbox, mobile UI benchmark, or training recipe. The evaluation surface is a task episode over a production platform, including user goal, required documents or fields, browser trajectory, and final-submission interception.

It matters because many web-agent benchmarks avoid real side effects by using offline replicas; ClawBench tests the harder live-site setting while trying to block the final real-world action.

ClawBench 问的是 AI 网页智能体能否在真实生产网站上完成日常在线任务。主来源是 2026 年 arXiv 论文 “ClawBench: Can AI Agents Complete Everyday Online Tasks?”，项目页在 arXiv 备注中列为 https://claw-bench.com。

边界是：它是真实网页智能体基准，不是静态网页沙箱，不是移动端界面基准，也不是训练配方。评测表面是生产平台上的任务回合，包括用户目标、所需文档/字段、浏览器轨迹和最终提交拦截。

它重要是因为很多网页智能体基准用离线副本避免真实副作用；ClawBench 测更难的真实网站设置，同时试图阻断最终真实提交。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The core contribution is a benchmark of 153 everyday online tasks across 144 live platforms and 15 categories. Tasks include workflows such as purchases, appointments, and job applications.

The closest comparison is static web-agent evaluation in sandboxed or mirrored sites. ClawBench changes the substrate by using production websites and a lightweight interception layer that captures and blocks only the final submission request.

The feedback contract is environmental: an agent must navigate multi-step workflows and reach a successful final submission state without causing real-world side effects.

核心贡献是一个包含 153 个日常在线任务的基准，覆盖 144 个真实平台和 15 个类别。任务包括购买、预约、求职申请等流程。

最近的参照物是沙箱或镜像网站上的静态网页智能体评测。ClawBench 的变化是使用生产网站，并通过轻量拦截层捕获并阻断最终提交请求。

反馈契约是环境式的：智能体必须完成多步流程，到达成功的最终提交状态，同时不能造成真实世界副作用。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs are user tasks, live websites, optional user-provided documents, account or form state, and an agent browser scaffold. The agent observes pages, navigates workflows, fills forms, uploads or uses provided information, and attempts the final action.

The benchmark intercepts the final submission request so evaluation can observe whether the agent reached the intended terminal state while avoiding actual purchases, bookings, or applications. Outputs are trajectories, intercepted final-action evidence, and task success status.

Reuse requires pinning the task list, live-site date, account setup, user documents, browser/runtime stack, action budget, interception logic, and safety policy.

输入包括用户任务、真实网站、可选的用户提供文档、账号/表单状态和智能体浏览器脚手架。智能体观察页面、推进流程、填写表单、上传或使用给定信息，并尝试最终动作。

基准会拦截最终提交请求，使评测能观察智能体是否到达预期终止状态，同时避免真实购买、预约或申请。输出是轨迹、被拦截的最终动作证据和任务成功状态。

复用前必须固定任务列表、真实网站日期、账号设置、用户文档、浏览器/运行时栈、动作预算、拦截逻辑和安全策略。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The arXiv record verifies the benchmark scale: 153 simple tasks across 144 live platforms and 15 categories. It also verifies the key design contrast against offline sandboxes and the final-submission interception layer.

The abstract reports that 7 frontier models were evaluated and gives Claude Sonnet 4.6 at 33.3%, supporting the claim that the live tasks remain difficult. This number is only meaningful under the paper's task set, agent scaffolds, live-site state, and safety interception setup.

The strongest evidence is a successful intercepted final submission attempt for a particular task. Aggregate success rate alone does not show whether failures came from navigation, document use, form filling, account state, or site drift.

arXiv 记录核实了基准规模：153 个简单任务，覆盖 144 个真实平台和 15 个类别。它也核实了与离线沙箱的关键对比，以及最终提交拦截层。

摘要报告评测了 7 个前沿模型，并给出 Claude Sonnet 4.6 为 33.3%，支持真实网站任务仍有难度的说法。这个数字只在论文的任务集合、智能体脚手架、真实网站状态和安全拦截设置下有意义。

最强证据是某个具体任务中被成功拦截的最终提交尝试。聚合成功率本身不能说明失败来自导航、文档使用、表单填写、账号状态还是网站漂移。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior baseline is web-agent evaluation on static pages, mirrored websites, or controlled sandboxes. ClawBench changes the setting by moving to production websites while intercepting the final high-stakes action.

The direction signal is that realistic web-agent evaluation needs both live environmental complexity and safety controls. The quality signal is the explicit scale across platforms and categories.

What is not new is browser automation itself. Before reuse, inspect artifact access, site terms, account setup, task stability, and whether interception truly prevents side effects.

已有基线是静态页面、镜像网站或受控沙箱上的网页智能体评测。ClawBench 的变化是进入生产网站，同时拦截最终高风险动作。

方向信号是现实网页智能体评测同时需要真实环境复杂性和安全控制。质量信号是跨平台和跨类别的明确规模。

不新的是浏览器自动化本身。复用前要检查工件访问、网站条款、账号设置、任务稳定性，以及拦截是否真正阻止副作用。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Correctness is relative to live websites at a specific time. UI, prices, policies, authentication, forms, and platform anti-automation behavior can change quickly.

The safety layer blocks final submission, but partial side effects before the final request remain an audit concern. Some tasks may require realistic personal documents, credentials, or payment-like state.

Without a verified harness release, public task split, and license terms, ClawBench should be treated as a promising benchmark surface rather than a fully reusable dataset.

正确性只相对于某个时间点的真实网站成立。界面、价格、政策、身份验证、表单和平台反自动化行为都可能快速变化。

安全层阻断最终提交，但最终请求之前的部分副作用仍需审计。有些任务可能需要逼真的个人文档、凭证或类似支付的状态。

如果没有核验评测框架发布、公开任务划分和许可条款，ClawBench 应被视为有潜力的基准表面，而不是完全可复用数据集。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use ClawBench as a reference for live-web agent evaluation design. It is especially useful when a project needs to test document use, multi-step form filling, and production-site navigation.

Reusable records should keep task id, platform, category, account state, user documents, browser trace, final intercepted request, success status, action budget, runtime date, and safety policy.

For audits, separate capability failure from environmental drift and from safety-blocking behavior.

ClawBench 适合作为真实网页智能体评测设计的参考。它特别适合测试文档使用、多步表单填写和生产网站导航。

可复用记录应保留任务 ID、平台、类别、账号状态、用户文档、浏览器轨迹、最终被拦截请求、成功状态、动作预算、运行日期和安全策略。

审计时要分开能力失败、环境漂移和安全阻断行为。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
Do not compare ClawBench scores as if the web were static. The runtime date and platform state are part of the result.

Read the interception layer carefully: it is the key difference between realistic production-site tasks and unsafe real submissions.

A high score should imply robust workflow completion, not just page navigation. Inspect whether forms, documents, and final action semantics were handled correctly.

不要像网页是静态的一样比较 ClawBench 分数。运行日期和平台状态是结果的一部分。

要仔细读拦截层：这是现实生产网站任务和不安全真实提交之间的关键差异。

高分应意味着稳健完成流程，而不只是页面导航。需要检查表单、文档和最终动作语义是否处理正确。
